description: The site's visitors, agents, page views, bounce rate and visit length over the last `days` days, the same figures for the same number of days before, visitors and agents by day, the agents by name, its most visited pages, entry pages, sources (a referring host or a link's utm_source), countries (ISO codes) and devices, and what visitors searched the site for and found nothing. A visitor is one browser on one day, counted without cookies. An agent (an AI crawler, an MCP client, or anything reading the site's markdown, llms.txt or .well-known files) is counted the same way and never among the visitors.

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: get_stats
title: Visitors
